title: EP Hermes agent prompt for four-layer personal second-brain OS
summary: Poster summarizes EP's single Hermes-agent prompt that boots four connected layers: a markdown knowledge base, a persistent memory pointer, capture/retrieve/correct skills, and a private life tracker for habits and goals synced across sessions.
question_it_answers: What four layers does EP's Hermes life-OS prompt install for a personal second brain?

claims.text: Layer one is a markdown knowledge base that acts as the source of truth.
claims.evidence: 1. a markdown knowledge base that is your source of truth
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Layer two is a persistent memory pointer so every future session knows where the vault lives.
claims.evidence: 2. a persistent memory pointer so every future session knows where it lives
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Layers three and four add agent skills for context capture and a private life tracker synced across sessions.
claims.evidence: 3. agent skills for capturing, retrieving, and correcting context
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Reply asked whether the prompt uses Daniel Miessler LifeOS. First-party is github.com/danielmiessler/LifeOS MIT, 18,886★, homepage ourlifeos.ai 200 / 113,753 B. README names Hermes as one install harness and a Hermes sidecar as a second front door. Do not collapse EP’s four-layer prompt with LifeOS, with Greg Mushen’s Hermes layer name, or with NousResearch/hermes-agent (MIT 241,533★ / homepage 90,409 B v0.21.0).
